names: Sodium tartrates (i) Monosodium tartrate (ii), Disodium tartrate

more_info.overview: Sodium tartrates is used as a stabilizer in food. Its technological role is to help maintain the structure of food.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include canned or bottled fruit and vegetables. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.daily_intake: 0-30 mg/kg body weight (JECFA, 1973). The combined group limit is expressed as L(+)-tartaric acid.
